title: Chapo Launches Pró-Jovem Youth Financing Programme
summary: President Chapo announced the launch of Pró-Jovem in Pemba, Cabo Delgado, replacing the Fund for Support to Youth Initiatives (FAIJ) to expand financing for youth projects across all districts. The programme will operate along the lines of PRO-MULHER and FDEL. Chapo also announced the government would double the value of its programme contract with the National Youth Council.
